frozenFiles.note: 2026-09-20 daemon v2.1.1 hotfix: remove the 600-second total download ceiling so transfers that keep receiving bytes can complete on slow links. Keep the 15-second connection timeout, bound waiting for response headers to 2 minutes, and abort bodies after 2 minutes without data. Streaming, progress callbacks, endpoints, asset names, HTTP error handling and checksum verification remain unchanged. ReleaseClientDownloadTest verifies continued progress across multiple timeout windows and stalled/late response cancellation.

2026-09-11 observability: add bounded upgrade diagnostics and a post-switch receipt; preserve CLI symlink resolution, asset names, checksums, install paths, version switching and service identity. 2026-09-14 #364: recognize Homebrew/Scoop layouts and emit their upgrade commands only on the matching host OS; a managed layout still takes priority and unrecognized layouts get the host installer one-liner. Stable asset names, checksum validation, install paths, service identity, executable names, package-manager package ids and legacy CLI commands remain unchanged. UpdateServiceTest covers host-scoped classification and cross-platform command rejection; reviewed third-batch change. 2026-09-14 #381-A: apply accepts an optional phase/download-progress listener (default quiet; listener exceptions are swallowed) rendered by the update CLI on stderr and kept silent for background auto-update. Asset names, checksum validation, temp-dir cleanup, install paths, version switching, service identity, executable names and legacy CLI commands remain unchanged. UpdateProgressTest covers terminal and redirected output plus checksum/HTTP failure without switching the launcher.

2026-10-05 retired features: Collaborator Links no longer have a separate collab_links store (not read, not cleared) and BindingRole drops GUEST (folder share, removed; no released build ever stored it, every redeem defaulted to OWNER). BindingRole stays a plain lowercase string with the tolerant decode, so a stored 'guest', 'collaborator', an unknown or absent role never fails the list decode: unknown values degrade to OWNER. Device keys, the paired-list and active-account storage keys, the legacy single-record migration, the relay redeem request, the default relay and the 6-digit code resolution are unchanged. BindingRoleStoreTest covers the legacy role strings.

2026-10-05 retired features (ReviewRequest, Session Handoff, Collaborator Links, Folder Share): the review-contact, collab, handoff and share hosts are recognised by host alone and parse to IncomingLink.Retired, which callers answer with a 'feature retired' notice and no pairing attempt or pair_failed; the payload is never decoded. A bare blob is no longer an invite at the paste entry and falls through to the pre-scheme pair forms. The ccpocket:// scheme, the pair (full link and 6-digit code) and session hosts, and legacy bare pair query strings and codes parse exactly as before. IncomingLinkTest and RetiredFeaturesTest cover every retired host, corrupt payloads, case variants and the unchanged pair/session routes.

2026-09-11 observability: optional diagnostic context and connection IDs; capability defaults false. Existing wire names, identity and E2E payload semantics preserved; DiagnosticWireCompatTest covers older peers and malformed metadata. 2026-09-13 #376: append nullable SessionLive.notice with a null default; null is omitted and legacy clients ignore the optional informational field. Existing frame names, lifecycle fields, identity and E2E semantics remain unchanged. SessionNoticeWireCompatTest covers legacy decoding and null omission; independent wire review passed. 2026-09-14 #362: append trailing optional DaemonInfo.supportsProjectPins and ClientCaps.supportsProjectPins, both defaulting to false; project pin frames live in ProjectPins.kt and are never sent to a peer that did not advertise the capability. Existing identity, key derivation, frame names, default behavior and E2E semantics remain unchanged. ProjectPinsWireCompatTest covers absent-capability decoding both ways, unknown pin frames and unknown keys; independent additive wire review passed. 2026-09-14 #360 phase two: append trailing optional ClientCaps.supportsManagedSessions (false), DaemonInfo.supportsManagedSessions (false) and DaemonInfo.managedAgents (empty); managed session frames live in ManagedSessions.kt and are never sent to a peer that did not advertise the capability. ListSessions/Sessions shapes, existing frame names, identity and E2E semantics remain unchanged. ManagedSessionsWireCompatTest covers absent-capability decoding both ways, legacy list shape, unknown managed frames, enums, keys and missing/unknown agents (never read as Claude); frames are paged under a 3 MiB encoded byte budget. Independent wire re-review: compatible; security review fixes applied. 2026-09-15 #380 live folding: append trailing optional ToolEvent.outcomeOnly (false) and ClientCaps.supportsToolOutcomes (false); a bare outcome RESULT for an ordinary tool is emitted only to a connection that advertised the capability, so undeclared peers keep the START-only stream. Existing frame names, identity, key derivation and E2E semantics remain unchanged. SerializationRoundTripTest covers legacy decoding both ways and the old-client concrete serializer; RequestRouterToolOutcomesTest covers the per-connection gate. 2026-09-19 #389: append optional RegisterPush.requestId (null, omitted for legacy peers), PROTO_V_PUSH_ACK=5 and the opt-in PushRegistrationResult receipt. The relay acknowledges only requests carrying a request ID; clients wait for receipts only after relay protocol capability negotiation. Legacy registration frames, identity, key derivation and E2E semantics are preserved. Push registration wire compatibility and relay ACK tests cover legacy silence, capability negotiation, stored/cleared/error receipts and stale-connection fencing. 2026-09-22 #394/#396: append defaulted SessionLive.contextUsedAuthoritative, SessionLive.compactSummary and HistoryMessage.compactSummary. Existing discriminators, request shapes, routes, package identities and E2E remain unchanged. Old clients ignore the new fields without interpreting compact summaries as output receipts; old daemons retain seed-only context semantics. CompactWireCompatTest and SerializationRoundTripTest cover old defaults, null omission, new/old shapes and Envelope round trips. Dedicated protocol compatibility review completed. 2026-09-24 dsh auto-repair: append trailing optional PocketError.repair (AgentRepairOffer, null) and add the AgentRepairStart (phone->daemon) and AgentRepairProgress (daemon->phone) frames for the one-tap reinstall of an incomplete dsh install. The offer rides the error the user already sees; a null repair is omitted so old apps see no button, an old daemon never sets it, and the new frames are only exchanged between peers that understand them (the app sends AgentRepairStart only after rendering an offer; the daemon replies AgentRepairProgress only to that request). Existing discriminators, frame names, identity, key derivation and E2E semantics remain unchanged. AgentRepairWireCompatTest covers old-client decoding both ways, null omission and frame round trips. 2026-09-26 iOS 1 MiB frame cap: append trailing optional ClientCaps.maxFrameBytes (0 = undeclared). The daemon shrinks outbound frames to the declared cap and treats an undeclared peer as 1 MiB; old daemons ignore the field. Existing discriminators, frame names, identity, key derivation and E2E semantics remain unchanged. FrameFitter tests and WireFrameCapGuardTest (Ktor >= 3.3.2) cover the cap. 2026-09-30 voice memo: append trailing optional ClientCaps.supportsVoiceMemo (false), DaemonInfo.voiceMemoVersion (0), DaemonInfo.voiceMemoAgents (empty) and DaemonInfo.voiceMemoStatus ("unknown"); memo frames live in VoiceMemo.kt and are only exchanged between peers that declared (caps) and announced (version >= 1) the capability, so old apps and old daemons see nothing. Existing discriminators, frame names, identity, key derivation and E2E semantics remain unchanged. VoiceMemoWireTest covers default decoding both ways, unknown-word tolerance and the v2 organiser/transcribed contract; independent wire review of the additive fields passed. 2026-10-05 retired features: comments only. The folder-share types (CreateShare, ListShares, RevokeShare, ShareCreated, ShareListing, ShareRevoked, ShareEnded) and the session-handoff push fields (PROTO_V_TARGETED_PUSH, NotifyPush.deviceId, NotifyPush.handoffId) are marked retired and kept for compatibility; PairBegin.collaborator is noted as still used by the execution-link mint. No declaration, @SerialName, field, default or enum value changed; identity, key derivation, frame names and E2E semantics are unchanged. The daemon answers ListShares with an empty ShareListing and CreateShare/RevokeShare with unsupported (RetiredFramesTest), and still sends ShareEnded once to an online legacy guest when it retires that credential.
